title: Wire completion signal into release summary
description: Optionally extend scripts/release_check_summary.py to ingest tasks completion output as non-blocking signal for unified readiness reporting.

criteria: Release summary includes tasks completion metric in details section.
Signal remains non-blocking unless explicitly configured otherwise.
Machine-readable payload includes completion fields for downstream tools.

Validate generated report includes tasks completion section after script run.

implementation: Invoke completion checker in soft mode from summary script.
Parse JSON output and append check entry with detail text.
Keep existing P0 gate logic unchanged.
test: Run python scripts/release_check_summary.py and verify report contains completion metrics with GO/NO_GO behavior unchanged for P0 checks.
